summary: Iteration 15 tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed — security headers present (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options DENY, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy) on all API responses; HSTS is set conditionally on request.url.scheme==https but was ABSENT on external HTTPS responses because the app runs behind proxy that forwards scheme as http (minor bug — see below). Rate limit login (10/min per IP) returns 429 on requests 11/12. PDF endpoint returns 200 with application/pdf + %PDF header + Content-Disposition attachment; file size ~>50KB confirming embedded photo. Authz: unauthenticated → 401, expired-subscription user (siti) → 403, non-existent CV → 404. Auth regression (login/me/admin/company) OK. Jobs, meta, companies OK. Frontend (Playwright): demo-accounts-info + forgot-password-link render in preview; CV Builder photo flow (load/preview/remove) OK for existing CV; Download PDF from Builder downloads CV Budi.pdf; New unsaved CV → 'Simpan CV terlebih dahulu' error toast shown; CvList (/candidate/cv-professional/list) download-<id> triggers direct PDF download without navigation; mobile 390px no overflow.

minor.issue: HSTS header is only set when request.url.scheme == 'https', but FastAPI runs behind a reverse proxy/ingress that forwards requests as http internally, so HSTS is never set on external HTTPS responses. Fix: check X-Forwarded-Proto header (or trust proxy) e.g. `request.headers.get('x-forwarded-proto', request.url.scheme) == 'https'`.

action_items: (Minor) Fix HSTS header emission behind proxy by consulting X-Forwarded-Proto so `Strict-Transport-Security` is present on HTTPS responses served via ingress.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4250 lines — should be split into routers/modules for maintainability.
Rate limiter is in-memory per-process; will not work correctly with multiple workers/replicas. Acceptable for MVP; document limitation.
HSTS scheme check should respect X-Forwarded-Proto for reverse-proxy deployments (see minor issue).

context_for_next_testing_agent: CvList lives at /candidate/cv-professional/list (not /candidate/cv-professional which is Career Pro overview). Login rate limit is 10/min per IP — run rate-limit tests last and sleep 60s+ before subsequent login tests. WeasyPrint PDF endpoint at GET /api/cv-professional/cvs/{id}/pdf returns ~>120KB when photo embedded.
rca of the issue: HSTS missing on external HTTPS: middleware uses request.url.scheme which reflects the internal ASGI scheme (http) when Uvicorn is behind an ingress/CDN that terminates TLS. Need to configure Uvicorn with --proxy-headers/forwarded-allow-ips or read X-Forwarded-Proto explicitly in the middleware condition.
